t: This is a building in Kensington, and the material I have on it is thin. What I can tell you is that it was designed by two Czech architects, Jan Bočan and Jan Šrámek. Bočan, born in 1937, was also a university educator, and Šrámek, born in 1924, worked as an architect too. Their names are the reason to look more closely at this one.
